root_idea.summary: The root centers on الميل: swerving or inclining away from a proper or central course.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends from physical or lateral deviation to injustice in judgment, and to taking or diminishing something from its sides.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form حَافَ rather than the attested imperfect form يَحِيفَ.

senses.definition: To swerve from right judgment into injustice; to act wrongfully or tyrannically against someone.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction حَافَ عَلَيْهِ, the affected person is the one against whom injustice is committed; the usage concerns unjust deviation in judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Giving some of one's children preferentially while withholding equal treatment from the others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for unequal allocation or parental favoritism.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Taking something from its side and thereby diminishing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun describing removal or reduction from a lateral portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take something little by little from its sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V construction describing gradual removal from the lateral portions.
The plural is حِيَفٌ; the word is also reported with the plural حَافَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who acts wrongfully, unjustly, injuriously, or tyrannically.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial or adjectival designation for one characterized by unjust action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow that declines from the right direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical application of deviation from a proper course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An impotent man who does not attain the object of his desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use likening failure to attain one's aim to deviation from the proper course.
A nominal use for a mountain's lateral side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A district or land upon which rain has not fallen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description explained as though the rain had treated the place unjustly.
